name: Leadership
title: Training for leaders and managers
lead: From team management to strategic thinking — practical programmes for those who lead others.

formTitle: Order a development programme for your team
formLead: We will tailor the format and content to your needs, from coaching to team training. We will send a proposal on the day you contact us.

faq.q: What leadership training do you offer?
faq.a: We run 12+ courses for managers: leadership and team management, business negotiation, conflict management, time management, emotional intelligence, public speaking, coaching, strategic thinking.

faq.q: How much does leadership training cost?
faq.a: On the 2026 schedule — {minPrice} to {maxPrice} ₸ per participant, depending on the course and format. Online is cheaper than in person.

faq.q: Is the training suitable for line managers?
faq.a: Yes, we have programmes for different levels: from line managers to top management. The trainer adapts cases and exercises to the participants' level.
The format is 20% theory and 80% practice, including business simulations, real-world business cases, group exercises, and individual feedback from the trainer.

faq.q: Can I order corporate leadership training?
faq.a: Yes, we run corporate leadership training built around the company's tasks and travel to regions across Kazakhstan. Since 2015 we have trained more than 50,000 specialists.
Yes, the schedule includes business negotiation courses — "Effective Negotiation" and "Negotiation Mastery", with hands-on practice on cases.
